parsed.historical_notes: This index lists Swiss firms and British firms with Swiss connections. They include watchmakers such as Ulysse Nardin, Le Coultre, Paillard and Record Dreadnought; food companies such as Nestlé & Anglo-Swiss and Peter, Cailler, Kohler; and chemical, textile and trading houses such as Sandoz and Sarasin. The mix of English and French corporate forms (Ltd., S. A., A. G., Cie.) suggests the page comes from an Anglo-Swiss trade directory or commercial publication. The Peter, Cailler, Kohler name dates it to roughly the 1910s–1920s, before that company merged with Nestlé in 1929.
